display_fil: Itama ang madulas na pasukan. Suriin ang sharps box, hand-hygiene supplies at PPE. Tiyakin ang ligtas na ruta at incident contact. Kulang ang proteksyon o lampas sa training? Mag-pause at kausapin ang supervisor.
display_en: Correct the slippery entrance. Check the sharps container, hand-hygiene supplies and PPE. Confirm a safe route and incident contact. Missing protection or beyond training? Pause and contact the supervisor.

display_fil: Suriin ang panahon, daan, aso at banta. Ipaalam ang ruta at oras ng balik; buddy kung kailangan sa protocol. Magdala ng tubig, planuhin ang lilim at pahinga. Huwag pumasok sa hindi ligtas na sitwasyon.
display_en: Check weather, paths, dogs and threats. Share the route and return time; use a buddy when the protocol requires it. Carry water and plan shade and rest. Do not enter an unsafe situation.

display_fil: Mainit, maraming kliyente at kulang ang PPE: tukuyin ang ihihinto, maaaring baguhin at kailangang pasya ng supervisor. Isama ang staffing at daloy ng kliyente; hindi puro dagdag-oras ng BHW ang sagot.
display_en: Heat, a client surge and missing PPE: identify what pauses, what can change and what needs a supervisor’s decision. Consider staffing and client flow; extra BHW hours cannot be the only response.

display_fil: Bago umalis: saklaw, supplies, ruta, contact, oras ng balik, pause conditions. Iulat ang kulang at kumuha ng ligtas na alternatibo.
display_en: Before leaving: scope, supplies, route, contact, return time, pause conditions. Report gaps and arrange a safe alternative.

display_fil: Ang checklist ay dapat may desisyon kung ligtas nang magsimula, hindi listahan lamang ng gamit.
display_en: A checklist must support a decision about safe starting conditions, not just list equipment.

check.prompt_fil: May banta sa ruta ngunit mahaba pa ang visit list. Ano ang ligtas na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: There is a threat on the route but many visits remain. What is safe?

options.fil: Iwasan ang banta at ayusin ang alternatibo kasama ang supervisor.
options.en: Avoid the threat and arrange an alternative with the supervisor.

options.fil: Huwag ipaalam ang pagbabago ng ruta upang hindi makaabala.
options.en: Change the route without telling anyone to avoid disruption.

check.feedback_fil: Ang ikalawang sagot ay inuuna ang ligtas na paraan at koordinasyon. Ang visit target ay hindi dahilan upang pumasok sa banta; kailangan pa ring alam ang ruta at oras ng balik.
check.feedback_en: The second response secures a safe approach and coordination. Visit targets do not justify entering danger; the route and return time still need to be known.
